_doc: Hand-verified inputs for scripts/upcoming-topup.mjs. Only list a card here after looking at the image: `art` must be an English scan of that exact card number (Bulbapedia/PokeBeach file names do not say the language reliably — e.g. PokeBeach's 078-Eevee.jpg is the Spanish print). `artist` fills a credit Bulbapedia hasn't posted yet. Never add a card that no official/English source has shown.
